title: Iran is ready for talks with US, but there are no plans yet, foreign minister says
description: Iran is ready for dialogue to resolve tensions with the United States but there are no concrete plans for talks with Washington, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Friday, even as Tehran faces the threat of US military action in response to the killing of peaceful demonstrators and over possible mass executions.
